High-Income Store Spender.description: Wealthy, educated customers who shop in-store and spend heavily across all categories.
High-Income Store Spender.language_style: Elevated vocabulary, longer sentences, no slang, subtle elegance
key_messages: You deserve the finest — and we deliver it.
Exclusively curated for discerning tastes.
Quality that speaks for itself.
A world of premium products, personally selected for you.
content_focus: Highlight premium product quality and provenance
Emphasise exclusivity and limited availability
Reference craftsmanship, heritage, and expertise
Use lifestyle imagery that reflects luxury and refinement
High-Income Store Spender.campaign_approach: Multi-touchpoint storytelling journey — build desire before presenting product

Budget-Conscious Low Spender.description: Price-sensitive customers who spend minimally and rarely respond to campaigns.
Budget-Conscious Low Spender.language_style: Simple vocabulary, short sentences, plain and clear, no jargon
Budget-Conscious Low Spender.emotional_appeal: Security, practicality, value for money, trust
key_messages: Great quality doesn't have to cost more.
Smart choices for everyday living.
We respect your budget — and your intelligence.
Real value, real savings, real results.
content_focus: Lead with price and value proposition
Highlight savings and affordability clearly
Use simple, relatable everyday scenarios
Focus on practical benefits over aspirational lifestyle
avoid: Imagery or language that feels out of reach
Budget-Conscious Low Spender.campaign_approach: Reactivation campaigns with clear value offers — keep messaging simple and honest

Web-Savvy Mid-Tier Buyer.description: Mid-income customers who prefer online shopping and are comfortable with digital content.
Web-Savvy Mid-Tier Buyer.language_style: Conversational, punchy, uses digital-native expressions, emoji-friendly
Web-Savvy Mid-Tier Buyer.emotional_appeal: Convenience, discovery, smart choices, staying current
key_messages: Shop smarter. Live better.
Everything you need, right here, right now.
Discover what's trending — curated just for you.
Fast. Easy. Delivered to your door.
content_focus: Emphasise convenience and seamless online experience
Highlight new arrivals, trending products, and personalised picks
Use short punchy copy with strong visual support
Include social proof — ratings, reviews, popular picks
avoid: Outdated references or out-of-touch cultural references
Web-Savvy Mid-Tier Buyer.campaign_approach: Digital-first campaigns with retargeting — use web behaviour signals to personalise

Deal-Seeking Value Hunter.description: Low-income customers who only engage when there is a compelling deal or discount.
Deal-Seeking Value Hunter.language_style: Short punchy sentences, numbers and percentages prominent, action-oriented
Deal-Seeking Value Hunter.emotional_appeal: FOMO (fear of missing out), urgency, winning a deal, smart shopping
key_messages: Today only — don't miss out.
Your exclusive deal is waiting.
Up to 50% off. Right now.
Act fast — limited stock at this price.
content_focus: Lead with the discount or offer — make it the headline
Include specific numbers (%, $ saved, items remaining)
Use countdown language and limited-time framing
Keep copy minimal — let the offer speak
avoid: Long explanations before revealing the deal
Deal-Seeking Value Hunter.campaign_approach: Trigger-based campaigns tied to promotions — only contact when there is a genuine deal

Highly Engaged Campaign Responder.description: The rarest and most responsive segment — actively responds to campaigns across touchpoints.
Highly Engaged Campaign Responder.language_style: Warm and personal, uses 'you' frequently, acknowledges their loyalty
key_messages: You've been with us from the start — here's something special.
As one of our most valued customers, this is for you.
Thank you for your loyalty. You deserve this.
Exclusively for our most engaged community members.
content_focus: Acknowledge and reward their engagement history
Offer early access, exclusives, or loyalty rewards
Use personalised language that references their behaviour
Build on the relationship — reference previous campaigns
avoid: Treating them like a new customer
Highly Engaged Campaign Responder.campaign_approach: Loyalty-first campaigns — reward before asking. Use full 6-step campaign sequences.
